answer_1.quote: The purpose of this paper is to bring into view the task of controllable text editing, as a step beyond one-shot generation towards interactive document generation.

answer_2.quote: We consider several metrics to evaluate our model. One natural metric to consider is BLEU... we compute the precision and F1 score... Finally, we compute sentence-level accuracy...

answer_4.quote: We conducted two rounds of human evaluations, each time across 200 examples from our test set. Annotators were crowd sourced, and each example was rated by seven judges for a total of 1400 judgements.
answer_4.guideline: Judges were asked to choose which system better accomplished the command and which was more faithful to the grounding, and to rate the satisfactoriness of model outputs.
